store.shell.title: Store
store.shell.subtitle: UMTUBA
store.hero.shopSubtitle: Discover active products from UMTUBA sellers and creators — catalog prices only, no invented deals.
store.trust.catalogPricesBody: What you see is the live offer — no invented promotions.
store.trust.quotedAtCheckoutBody: Tax, delivery, and discounts appear only from a server quote.
store.trust.oneSellerBody: Multi-seller bags ship separately. No guessed delivery dates.
store.empty.catalogDescription: The catalog will appear here when authorized products are ready. Nothing is for sale yet.
store.empty.featuredDescription: Approved active listings will appear here when they are published.
store.empty.sellersDescription: Active stores with approved products will appear here.
store.empty.recommendedDescription: Recommendations appear once there is an active catalog.
store.empty.railDescription: Active products will appear when they are published.
store.empty.categoriesDescription: Categories will appear here once products are published.
store.home.featuredDescription: Active listings ranked by availability and recency — no fabricated popularity scores.
store.home.collectionsDescription: Category collections derived from products currently in the public catalog.
store.home.sellersDescription: Sellers with active catalog presence on UMTUBA.
store.home.moreDescription: Additional active catalog picks when inventory allows.
store.search.title: Search & categories
store.search.description: Filter active catalog products by keyword, category, and sort.
store.search.noMatchesDescription: Try another search term or clear category filters.
store.wishlist.emptyDescription: Save products from the store to find them here later.
store.cart.title: Your cart
store.cart.description: Prices are saved when items are added. Tax, delivery, and discounts appear only from a checkout quote.
store.cart.emptyDescription: Browse the Store and add products when you are ready.
store.cart.reviewBeforeCheckout: Cart updated. Review availability or price changes before checkout.
store.cart.qtyWhole: Quantity must be a whole number.
store.cart.paymentDeferred: Payment collection is not enabled. Checkout creates pending-payment orders only — no live charge.
store.cart.multiSeller: Items from {count} sellers will become {count} orders — not one shared shipment.
store.orders.title: My orders
store.orders.description: Each card is one seller order. Multi-seller checkouts appear as multiple orders — not one shared shipment.
store.orders.emptyDescription: When checkout confirms an order, it appears here.
store.orders.oneSellerNote: This is one seller order. Multi-seller checkouts create separate orders — not one shared shipment.
store.checkout.title: Review & place order
store.checkout.description: Totals are calculated server-side. Payment collection is not enabled — placing an order creates a pending-payment order only.
store.checkout.blocking: Some cart items have price or availability issues. Return to the cart and resolve them before placing an order.
store.checkout.resolveIssues: Resolve cart price or availability issues before placing an order.
store.checkout.emptyDescription: Add products to your cart before starting checkout.
store.product.fulfillmentWithPolicy: This seller publishes a shipping policy below. Delivery timing is determined at checkout — no estimated dates are invented here.
store.product.fulfillmentDefault: Fulfillment details are confirmed at checkout. No delivery dates or shipping fees are invented on this page.
store.product.videosEmpty: No shoppable videos have attached this product yet.
store.product.reviewsEmpty: Reviews and Q&A are not available yet — no fabricated ratings are shown.
store.demo.banner: Internal demo preview — not real inventory. Not purchasable. No live checkout.
store.demo.title: UMTUBA demo catalog
store.demo.subtitle: QA preview
store.demo.checkoutBlocked: Demo products cannot become a real checkout.
store.demo.deniedBody: This catalog is for authorized QA only and is hidden from ordinary shoppers.
store.profile.aboutEmpty: This store has not added an about section yet.
store.profile.videosBody: Shoppable videos for this storefront arrive in a later phase.
store.profile.liveBody: Live sessions from this store will appear here when Live Shopping ships.
store.profile.ratingsBody: Store ratings and reviews are placeholders until the ratings system launches.
